name: 피부 정반사 분석
description: Analyzes skin specular reflection patterns — AI-generated skin often has unrealistic specular highlights.
mechanism:
This method analyzes skin specular reflection for deepfake detection:

1. **SpecularComponent추출**: The specular (glossy) component of skin reflectance is separated from the diffuse (matte) component using dichromatic reflection model decomposition. Specular highlights appear where skin surface is oriented to reflect light directly toward the camera.

2. **SpecularHighlight분포**: The spatial distribution of skin specular highlights should follow the face's 3D geometry and illumination. The method checks highlight positions against expected locations — forehead center, nose bridge and tip, cheekbone apexes. AI generators may produce specular highlights at incorrect locations or with wrong intensity distributions.

3. **물리적SpecularModel**: Skin specular reflection follows the Torrance-Sparrow (microfacet) BRDF model with characteristic roughness parameters. The method measures specular highlight shape and falloff, comparing against physical skin reflectance models. Generated highlights may show non-physical profiles — too sharp, too broad, or incorrect Fresnel behavior.

4. **시간적SpecularDynamics**: As the head moves, specular highlights should slide across the face following the changing reflection geometry. The method tracks highlight positions relative to landmarks — highlights should move according to the rotation of the surface normal relative to the light direction. Incorrect highlight dynamics indicate AI generation.

5. **Sweat/OilPhysics**: Facial skin specularity varies with surface moisture — oily regions (forehead, nose) are more specular. This distribution should be consistent across frames and follow physiological patterns. AI generators typically don't model skin moisture variation, producing uniform or incorrectly distributed specularity.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
